original.statement: Namespaced XRs are now blocked from composing cluster scoped resources.

decision.reason: [ev-eb6e8ebc20ee] says only that namespaced XRs are now blocked from composing cluster-scoped resources. That is a change in how composition behaves. No schema field, flag or other typed subject is named, so a protocol-behavior subject built from the text's own key words is acceptable. The text does not say whether the block happens at admission or at runtime, so behavior-changed is the strongest change type the evidence supports; validation-tightened would go beyond it.
